job: Enter one date by typing it or picking it from a calendar.
purpose: A text box that holds a date as YYYY-MM-DD, with a calendar button that opens the date range's month grid. The box posts the ISO date with no script; with script it reads other typed forms, checks data-min-date and data-max-date through setCustomValidity, and writes the ISO date back. Arrow keys open the calendar and move by day, week and month.
useWhen: A form needs one date: pause until, expires on, start on.
The date must stay inside a range, such as no earlier than today.

avoidWhen.when: A period with a start and an end.
A time of day, or a duration.
A choice among a few named dates, such as tomorrow or next week.

states.name: invalid
states.how: aria-invalid="true" on the input, with a .fd-field-error

states.name: disabled
states.how: disabled on the input and the button

states.name: ready
states.how: data-ready on the root once the script has run; the calendar button is hidden until then

variants.useWhen: No earlier date is allowed: an ISO date or today.
No later date is allowed: an ISO date or today.

parts.role: The root; carries data-fd-datefield and wraps an input group and the calendar popover.
The calendar inside the popover; carries data-fd-datepanel.
The Today and Clear buttons under the calendar.

keyboard.does: In the box, opens the calendar on the chosen day.
In the calendar, move by day and week.
Move by month; with Shift, by year.
Pick the day and return to the box.
